summary: Nixxy, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a binding letter of intent to acquire Tachyon 9 Corporation. The multi-step business combination values Tachyon's stock at approximately $1 billion, with Tachyon shareholders receiving Nixxy common stock at a variable conversion price based on a pre-disclosure VWAP, subject to a floor and cap. Post-closing, Tachyon stockholders are expected to hold at least 90% of the combined company. The deal targets Tachyon's proposed 620-acre hyperscale campus in North Dakota. Pre-closing, Tachyon will seek up to $75 million via a PIPE in convertible notes. What to watch: completion of due diligence on Tachyon's title and development rights; regulatory and shareholder approvals; the 'risk-arb' spread on Nixxy's stock.
